title: Full requirements list — bathtub waste-and-overflow trip-lever removal, San Francisco
method: Every requirement is traced to the place it originated: 'brief' = the requester's written project brief; 'derived' = inferred from the brief to make it testable; 'official' = required by a government source listed in source_url. Requirements with no official source are marked verified=false.

requirements.requirement: Remove the bathtub waste-and-overflow trip-lever assembly that is stuck inside the concealed plumbing behind the wall.
requirements.notes: Headline scope. The unit is tenant-occupied.

requirements.requirement: Restore the tub to a fully usable state: stopper seals when closed, drain runs freely when open.
requirements.official_source_label: Watco Trip Lever Bath Waste instructions (official manufacturer)
requirements.notes: Acceptance test defined by the manufacturer: fill the tub a few inches and operate the lever.

requirements.requirement: Do not destroy the concealed plumbing behind the wall.
requirements.notes: Reported reason five or more prior plumbers declined the from-above route.

requirements.requirement: Preferred: remove the assembly from above, through the overflow opening, with no demolition.
requirements.official_source_label: Watco Trip Lever Bath Waste instructions (official manufacturer)
requirements.notes: Manufacturer's documented service path reaches the whole mechanism through the overflow opening (see T-03).

requirements.requirement: Fallback: access from below through the ceiling of the storage unit, opening the drywall ceiling as needed.
requirements.notes: Requires consent/access arrangements for the space below; not verified — see flag F-12.

requirements.requirement: Provider must attempt and document the non-destructive route before cutting finished surfaces.
requirements.notes: Derived so REQ-04 is auditable rather than merely preferred.

requirements.requirement: Single provider covering BOTH plumbing and drywall/general building — one contract, one point of contact.
requirements.official_source_label: CSLB Check a Contractor License (official, State of California)
requirements.notes: Testable: the licence must carry C-36 plus B (or C-9), or the provider must name the licensed second trade. See the Providers page — 4 of 10 verified providers qualify on a single licence.

requirements.requirement: Provider must be a licensed plumber or licensed contractor.
requirements.official_source_label: California Business and Professions Code section 7048 (official)
requirements.notes: BPC 7048's sub- unlicensed exemption expressly does not apply when the work requires a permit.

requirements.requirement: Provider must hold an active licence with the correct classification, a current contractor bond, and active workers' compensation where they have employees.
requirements.official_source_label: CSLB License Detail pages (official, State of California) — one per provider
requirements.notes: All 10 candidates verified active on 2026-11-06. Three are workers'-comp exempt (no employees) — see flag F-04.

requirements.requirement: Provider must serve San Francisco.
requirements.official_source_label: CSLB License Detail pages (official, State of California)
requirements.notes: 8 of 10 verified providers have a San Francisco address of record; 2 are outside the city (see flag F-07).

requirements.requirement: Provider must demonstrate experience with delicate work in occupied/sensitive environments.
requirements.notes: No government source certifies 'experience'. Cannot be verified from an official source — left blank and flagged (F-08). Must be established by direct questioning and references.

requirements.requirement: Provider must have reviewable third-party reviews (Yelp or equivalent).
requirements.notes: Yelp returns HTTP 403 to automated retrieval; no government source for ratings. Ratings shown on the Providers page are unverified observations, not confirmed values (F-08).

requirements.requirement: Work is performed in a unit occupied by tenants.
requirements.notes: Drives REQ-14 through REQ-16.

requirements.requirement: Give the tenant reasonable written notice of intent to enter (date, approximate time, purpose); 24 hours is presumed reasonable. Enter only during normal business hours unless the tenant consents at the time.
requirements.notes: Exceptions: emergency, tenant present and consenting, or abandonment. The right of access may not be used to harass the tenant.

requirements.requirement: Protect the occupied unit: containment, floor and fixture protection, debris removal, and end-of-day cleanup.
requirements.notes: Derived from REQ-11/REQ-13. No official source mandates specific methods.

requirements.requirement: If access to the space below is a separate unit or common area, obtain the necessary consent before scheduling.
requirements.notes: Not verifiable from an official source — flagged F-12.

requirements.requirement: Determine, from DBI, whether this specific scope requires a plumbing permit before work starts.
requirements.official_source_label: SF.gov — Apply for a plumbing and mechanical permit (DBI)
requirements.notes: DBI states a permit is needed before cutting into or replacing pipes, particularly pipes that will be covered by a wall. Permit Center help desk: 628-652-4900.

requirements.requirement: If a permit is required, have the plumbing inspected BEFORE the pipes are covered.
requirements.official_source_label: SF.gov — Apply for a plumbing and mechanical permit (DBI)
requirements.notes: Sequencing requirement: patching drywall before the inspection defeats the inspection.

requirements.requirement: The permit must be pulled by a contractor holding an appropriate licence (C4, C16, C20, C36, C54, B or A, scope-dependent).
requirements.official_source_label: SF.gov — Apply for a plumbing and mechanical permit (DBI)
requirements.notes: Cross-reference REQ-07: a B+C36 licence satisfies both the permit rule and the all-in-one requirement.

requirements.requirement: Prefer a contractor already registered for Express Permits on PermitSF so the permit can be issued without City staff review.
requirements.official_source_label: SF.gov — Licensed contractors: register on PermitSF
requirements.notes: Directly addresses scheduling through the published Express Permits process.

requirements.requirement: Obtain a written, fixed-price scope covering plumbing AND the drywall open-and-patch, with a change-order clause for concealed damage found after opening.
requirements.notes: None of the three quotes in hand includes a drywall line item — see flag F-09.

requirements.requirement: Re-quote on a single, identical scope so the three numbers are comparable.
requirements.notes: Current quotes differ in scope (replacement vs. replacement of lever/plug/spout vs. adjustment) — see flag F-10.

requirements.requirement: Confirm quotes are still valid; the supplied quote date is 8/30/26, about 10 weeks before this review.
requirements.notes: See flag F-01.

requirements.requirement: Photograph before, during (while open) and after the work; retain the images with the job record.
requirements.notes: Also the only practical evidence for REQ-18 if an inspection is involved.

requirements.requirement: No private or sensitive information may appear on any public page, commit, email or shared artifact.
requirements.notes: Applied to this repository: the published site contains only publicly verifiable, officially sourced material. Private scheduling/permit constraints are deliberately excluded and are not stored in any committed file.

requirements.requirement: Every published table row must carry a link to the official source it was verified against; anything unconfirmed must be left blank and flagged.
requirements.notes: Enforced by tests/test_bathtub_site.py: any row without a source URL is rendered with an UNVERIFIED badge and fails the row check.

requirements.requirement: Reference photographs of the assembly should be attached to the job record.
requirements.notes: The brief said photos would be supplied. No images were present anywhere in the repository when this review ran — see flag F-13.

_amounts_policy: Quote amounts are withheld from this archived data file: no official source confirms them. The current figures and their labels are maintained in site-data/ and published on the canonical site root.
